input.quote: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 caps each Party's aggregate liability at Fees "actually paid" in a single month — far below our floor of the greater of 12 months' Fees and USD 1,000,000, and below even the walk-away threshold of six months' fees. "Fees" (Section 1.5) excludes taxes, expenses, credits and one-time implementation charges, so a one-month measure is close to illusory against risks such as a Security Incident (note Vendor carries USD 5,000,000 cyber cover under 18.1). The phrase "without exception" also overrides the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3, pulling indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection, security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside the cap. The cap is nominally mutual, so the fix is limited to the basis and restoring the carve-outs: we set the cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and reinstate Excluded Claims as uncapped. Sections 21.2–21.4 (mutual consequential-damages exclusion, Excluded Claims definition, payment obligations not "damages") already meet the playbook and are unchanged.

proposal.summary: Raise the liability cap to the greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1,000,000 and confirm Excluded Claims sit outside the cap
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have raised the mutual cap to the greater of twelve months' Fees (paid or payable) and USD 1,000,000, which is our standard position; a one-month fee cap is far below any meaningful measure of risk here. We also removed "without exception" so that the Excluded Claims in Section 21.3 — indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement — remain uncapped as that Section contemplates. Our fallback is a mutual cap of twelve months' Fees with those carve-outs preserved.

ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to this limitation, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
